description: The agent must: (1) Read the context dump and supporting ops files in the workspace to reconstruct the full situation. (2) Produce a file named `campaign_ops_brief.md` containing all 5 required output sections from the skill's Output Contract: Campaign Action Plan, Bidding and Budget Policy, AB Test and Scale Model, Monitoring and Alert Plan, and Operator Handoff Checklist. (3) Apply the CPA ceiling of $42 and ROAS floor of 2.5 from the campaign control spec in its bidding policy. (4) Invoke the alert trigger rule with BOTH conditions: roas_drop_pct > 20 AND spend_up_pct > 25, setting severity high and capping budget. (5) Apply the 'anomaly risk → containment first' decision rule before any scaling discussion. (6) Apply the 'low measurement confidence → fix tracking before scale' rule due to pixel degradation. (7) Recommend staged_scale budget mode for recovery. (8) Defer the A/B creative test because CPA is unstable — decision rules require reducing experiment concurrency under these conditions. (9) Include rollback conditions on all major recommendations per the 'no irreversible changes without rollback conditions' guardrail. (10) Address all three channels (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok Ads) explicitly in the brief. The key traps are: the dual-condition alert rule (agents often miss the AND logic), the decision rule priority ordering (containment before scale, tracking before scale), the specific numeric thresholds from the Code Examples section, the A/B test deferral tied to CPA instability, and the rollback condition requirement.
